name: Transcript Doctor
description: 转录体检：检查每个会话的 .jsonl.layout 行偏移索引是否与 .jsonl 对得上，脏了就备份并清理，避免 host-core 报 stream did not contain valid UTF-8 并永久暂停持久化队列。纯本地字节比对，不调用模型。
author: duya07

en.name: Transcript Doctor
en.description: Checks every session's .jsonl.layout line-offset cache against its .jsonl, and backs up + clears the stale ones before host-core starts reporting "stream did not contain valid UTF-8" and stalls the persistence queue. Pure local byte comparison, no model calls.
en.safetyNotes: Reads only ~/.pi-desktop/sessions/*.jsonl and *.jsonl.layout, logs/app/persistence.log and session-message-outbox.json. The only write is copying *.jsonl.layout / *.layout.tmp into the plugin data directory and then deleting the originals; .jsonl, .inflight.json and the outbox are never touched. No network requests, no model calls, no automatic code execution. Cleaning only takes effect after PI-Desktop restarts, because the host keeps the stale index in memory.

commands.title: 转录体检：备份并清理过期索引

agentTools.name: transcript_doctor
agentTools.description: 体检 PI-Desktop 的会话转录索引（~/.pi-desktop/sessions/*.jsonl.layout）。宿主 host-core 把每条消息的行偏移缓存在 .jsonl 旁边；转录被原地重写（流式回复落地、子代理 Task 状态更新）而缓存未失效时偏移会漂移，宿主 seek 到行中间或多字节 UTF-8 字符内部，报 stream did not contain valid UTF-8 并永久暂停持久化队列（消息积压在 session-message-outbox.json）。action=scan 列出有问题的会话（结果很小）；action=inspect 看单个会话完整字段（需要 sessionId）；action=clean 备份并删除过期索引（默认 dry-run，必须 confirm=true 才真的删除）；action=verify 返回每个会话一行摘要。清理只让下一次重启干净，宿主内存里的旧索引必须重启进程才会丢弃；本工具不重启宿主、不改 .jsonl 内容、不调用模型。

sessionId.description: inspect 必填；clean 可选，限定只清理该会话

confirm.description: clean 必须显式 true 才真正删除；省略或 false 时只返回将要删除的清单（dry-run）

settings.title: 后台自检（每 N 分钟扫一次）
发现问题时发系统通知
